name: collectu-core
description: The MCP server of a Collectu Core you run - its modules, its running pipeline, its logs and metrics - in Claude Code. Install the collectu plugin too for the skills and the Collectu Hub.

core_mcp_url.title: Core MCP server
core_mcp_url.description: The address of the Core's MCP server: http://<host>:<api_port>/mcp/v1/ - the Core has to run with mcp = 1 in its settings.ini.

core_token.title: Hub API access token
core_token.description: An API access token of the Collectu Hub (Account > API access tokens) of the Core's owner, with app:read (logs, metrics, the running pipeline), module:read, configuration:read, and task:create to start and stop modules and pipelines. Leave empty for a Core with api_authentication = 0.
